quoted_text: A graceful variation of the Piano series, Wedding Piano keeps the signature globular bud to fully cupped form—this time dressed in creamy white with soft blush undertones. Blooming generously through the season, it lends a timeless romantic elegance to any setting, with a delicate fragrance and exceptional durability.
